content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ESIC Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 08-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ESIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the ESIC Recruitment 2026 is 08 October 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in ESIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies announced for various posts including Medical Officer, Study Coordinator, Study Nurse, Laboratory Technician, and Field Worker in the ESIC Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application process for ESIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application process for ESIC Recruitment 2026 is via email. Candidates need to send their complete application along with required documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for applying to ESIC posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts in ESIC Recruitment 2026 is 35 years. Age relaxation will be applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for ESIC Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: For the Medical Officer post, candidates must possess an MBBS degree recognized by the National Medical Commission (NMC).

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for ESIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the ESIC Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Field Worker post?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary offered for the Field Worker post in ESIC Recruitment 2026 is Rs. 23400/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for ESIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves screening of applications, followed by a written test (if required), and an interview conducted by the Selection Panel.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from outside Haryana apply for these posts?
faq.answer: The notification specifies the location as Faridabad, Haryana. Candidates should check the official notification for any state-specific eligibility criteria or domicile requirements.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for ESIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is also available on the official ESIC website.
